description: `accounts limit <seat> <cap>` writes seat-state.json persistently. Only a CAPPED seat ever triggers the one live `agent list` call `_open_counts` makes (accounts.py: an uncapped seat never reaches it). Card 20261102-b-15ee38: the one scripted call below fails (exit 1), so `default_open_agent_counts` returns None rather than raising — None is read as AT-CAPACITY for a capped seat, not as zero open, the fail-open answer stays only on an uncapped seat. dispatch --dry-run then falls to the next chain entry with the exact 'open-agent count unreadable' wording. Re-recorded from the Python oracle (`conformance/run_scenario.py --impl python --python-repo <frozen checkout>`), which makes this exact `agent list` call too — the transcript used to be empty, which (verified against the oracle, not just this port) was always a latent gap in this fixture rather than evidence the call never happens.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-a]
kind = "codex"
short = "sa"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-a}}"
pool = "codex:a"

[accounts.seat-b]
kind = "codex"
short = "sb"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-b}}"
pool = "codex:b"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["seat-a", "seat-b"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
